reaction.episode: DIGESTION episode through the Oct 29 close, with Oct 30 midday tape extending it: SPX 7,720.39 is 1.58% below its 120-day high and 0.29% above its 50-day; SMH 561.67 is in Zone 1 (540-565), down 16.4% from its high, while NVDA 213.66 sits above Zone 1; VIX was 17.2 at the close but 21.17 live midday (+23.08% today) and HY OAS is 3.23 and calm; the mechanical capitulation tally is 2/4 confirmed (zone occupancy and credit calm; volume climax and VIX rollover not confirmed). Episode data is not stale.
reaction.invalidation: A SPX close below its 200-day ($7,306.49) while HY OAS breaks above 4% proves this is not digestion but a regime break, voiding the Watch stance and the ladder; equally, a held close above the SMH $580-600 / SPX $7,750-7,820 failure zone with the tally completing would prove the bottom is in and the Watch stance was too cautious.

ladder.response: Tranche A fires: deploy 25% of new money per the deployment ladder, sized to the zone print, not the headline.
ladder.trigger: SMH closes into Zone 2 ($470-505) or NVDA closes into Zone 2 ($175-185), with the mechanical tally at 3/6 or better

ladder.response: Treat as the bull-trap case: no chasing, no adds on the first bounce; wait for the retest verdict before any entry.

ladder.response: Stand down: the digestion read is broken, the ladder is void, new money stays in bills and existing exposure is reviewed for trim.
ladder.trigger: HY OAS breaks above 4% or VIX closes above 25, or SPX closes below its 200-day ($7,306.49)

ladder.response: Tranche C fires: deploy the remaining 50% on the confirmed bottom, not before.
ladder.trigger: Confirmed bottom per the ladder: a failed first bounce followed by a second low holding with the 10Y falling, or a held close above SPX $7,750-7,820 / SMH $580-600

reaction.trapRisk: The pivot-and-fail scenario is the live risk: SMH is 2.05% below its 50-day and the tape already showed a failed bounce pattern in the AI names, so the first bounce into the $580-600 failure zone is more likely a trap than a bottom. Entries change accordingly — no position is taken on a bounce alone; only a close above the failure zone, or a Zone 2 print with tally confirmation, earns size. Chasing the first green day after a 16.4% SMH drawdown is how the trap pays.

strategyPosture: Watch. The tape is a DIGESTION episode with the AI complex in Zone 1, not Zone 2, and the mechanical tally only 2/4 — the ladder's Tranche A trigger has not fired, so new money stays in bills while the DATA_AHEAD dislocations (AI infra, software) are researched, not chased.

themes.counterRead: Price says the cycle is over; the revenue prints say it is a derating, not a demand collapse. That gap is the opportunity — but it is not yet a buy: SMH sits in Zone 1, not Zone 2, and the mechanical tally is only 2/4, so the ladder keeps new money in bills until the Zone 2 print or a confirmed bottom. The risk is that the derating is the market correctly front-running a capex pause the revenue prints have not yet caught.

themes.counterRead: Rotation is the right read today, but it is fragile: the same divergence is what a rollover looks like in its first week. If HY OAS breaks above 4% or lending standards tighten, the rotation read fails and the Mag7 drawdown becomes the market. Until then, index-level calm is real and the damage is a leadership change, not a credit event.
themes.dataAnchor: The index itself disagrees with the rollover story. SPY is only 3.5% below its 52-week high and the SPX is 1.58% off its 120-day high, still 0.29% above its 50-day and 5.66% above its 200-day. The Mag7 average is 16.53% below its highs — a 13.03-point divergence gap — while bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 0%, far below the ~40% stress threshold) and HY OAS is 3.23, calm. The pain is concentrated in the names that dominate the index by weight, not in credit or breadth.
themes.label: Rotation, not rollover: Mag7 weakness vs index calm
themes.narrative: The tape looks like a broad rollover: QQQ fell 3.94% today and 7.39% in a month, VIX jumped 23.08% today to 21.17, and GOOGL is 32% below its high while META is 15.1% down in a month.
themes.watchFor: HY OAS holding below 4% and SLOOS staying loose while the Mag7-to-SPY divergence gap narrows or widens.

themes.counterRead: The narrative ran ahead of the power-demand data and is now giving the premium back; the stocks are correcting toward a story the grid buildout has not yet validated at these prices. VST's insider buying and shallower drawdown mark it as the relative-strength name in the theme, but a DETERIORATING revenue inflection means it is a watch, not a buy — the theme needs a demand print, not a sentiment turn.
